scope: Read-only native Harbor adapter source inspection and offline OpenCode help/binary inspection; no model prompts, API clients, credentials, task execution, or campaign edits.

shared_findings.finding: InstalledAgentOptions accepts version and skip_install; omitted version can select latest or any installed version.
With skip_install, a version mismatch only logs a warning and the detected version replaces the requested version. A separate exact-version admission assertion is required.
Agent execution uses the environment default user; preparation uses root. Explicit UID 1000 and writable HOME/log paths must be qualified. Config-file ownership depends on environment.default_user.
Harbor retry.max_retries defaults to zero; explicitly preserve zero for a single-attempt pilot. Native CLI HTTP retries are a separate unverified condition.
Both adapters emit ATIF-v1.7. Both copy final token fields into AgentContext with `or 0`; missing metrics must be reconciled from raw evidence rather than accepted as measured zero.

claude_code.model_resolution: Anthropic provider prefix is removed for ANTHROPIC_MODEL; direct provider credential is ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.
claude_code.installation: Debian install path downloads a mutable bootstrap shell script from downloads.claude.ai; use a prebuilt qualified image and skip_install for the pilot.
differences_from_lab: Harbor defaults permission_mode to bypassPermissions; lab sets dontAsk. Native option supports dontAsk.
Harbor does not pass lab's --setting-sources empty-string isolation flag. Clean per-trial HOME/project configuration and explicit safe native settings require qualification.
Harbor can use ambient Claude effort/output settings; sanitize inherited environment and record effective settings.
Harbor's observed session model has requested-model fallback; retain native response model evidence and any auxiliary models separately.
claude_code.accounting: Terminal CLI total_cost_usd takes precedence; absent terminal cost can be replaced with a labeled LiteLLM estimate. Missing per-message usage values can become zero. Reconcile raw terminal/session usage and provider billing.

opencode.status: source and installed flag compatibility established; live execution and permission behavior unverified
opencode.model_resolution: Provider/model selector is retained; direct anthropic connection uses ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and Anthropic Messages.
opencode.installation: Installer can install coreutils, Node/nvm and opencode-ai; use a prebuilt image with coreutils and skip_install to avoid runtime dependency drift.
differences_from_lab: Harbor hardcodes --thinking and --dangerously-skip-permissions, sets OPENCODE_FAKE_VCS=git and uses separate XDG storage.
The dangerous flag is a supported hidden alias for auto-approval, not an unsupported argument. It is absent from normal help because the installed parser marks it hidden.
Harbor opencode_config can explicitly set model/small_model/build-agent model and advisory steps; default configuration is empty.
Harbor has no native max_turns or max_budget_usd option; timeout and external spending admission remain required.
opencode.accounting: Only completed step_start/step_finish groups contribute. Prompt-token totals sum input plus cache-read, excluding cache-write (retained in extra). Requested configuration supplies ATIF model_name; it is not observed model identity. Zero totals become null in ATIF, then can become zero in AgentContext.

static_binary_inspection.method: Read the installed binary using Node fs.readFileSync in a network-none/read-only container. Search raw embedded JavaScript bytes; no harness prompt or execution path is invoked.
static_binary_inspection.byte_offsets_are: Zero-based byte offsets in the SHA-256-identified installed binary.
static_binary_inspection.conclusion: The hidden flag is parsed and used by Cli.run to auto-approve emitted permission requests. The public --auto help describes approval for permissions not explicitly denied. Actual tool deny/allow enforcement with a real model remains unverified.
